source.how: The sheet is an ArcGIS Pro GeoPDF: each map frame carries a /VP viewport with its CRS (NAD_1983_HARN_StatePlane_Oregon_North_FIPS_3601, feet = EPSG:2913) and four corner coordinates. The page-to-ground affine was fitted to those corners (residual 0.31 ft at each) and the map's own vector strokes were read out of the page by colour, so nothing was rendered, picked or flood-filled. Checked by laying the county's current taxlots over the result: the ASC outlines and the setback strokes run on the lot and right-of-way lines. ASC 2 is the closed outline Map 17 strokes in bright green (RGB 0.33, 1.00, 0.00), 16.8 acres. The standards bind a Kaiser-facing elevation, so an R-24 NB lot is INSIDE (whole lot drawn) when at least 90 percent of it is in ASC 2 and it fronts Kaiser Road (within 75 ft of the county centreline with no other taxlot between); UNANSWERED (the lot's part inside ASC 2 drawn, about half) when it fronts Kaiser and the ASC 2 line cuts it; OUTSIDE (not drawn) when it is outside ASC 2 or has no Kaiser frontage. No R-24 NB lot is wholly inside; two are cut.
